| **Section 2 — Methodology** | ✅ | PRISMA 2020 framework, search strategy, screening criteria, data extraction |
| **Section 3 — Results** | ✅ | 8 sub-bagian: overview, ML models, DL models, hybrid, input features, evaluation metrics, practical implementation, comparative analysis |
| **Section 4 — Discussion** | ✅ | 7 sub-bagian: interpretation, RQ mapping (4 RQ), literature gap, implications, limitations |
| **Section 5 — Conclusion** | ✅ | Ringkasan, kontribusi, future research directions |
| **References** | 🔴 | **41 referensi, tapi campur dengan AI di HE!** |
